capabilities: Rewrite selected text or the whole note with AI
Define reusable role prompts as markdown files in a vault folder
Apply or reject AI rewrites through a diff-based review queue
Attach review comments anchored to the text they discuss
Connect to cloud and local LLM providers with an API key or base URL
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a troubleshooting section (e.g. free-tier Gemini returning 400/404 errors) and an explicit roadmap with completed and planned items.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run LLM-based edits on a selection or a whole note and review the resulting changes one item at a time before applying them.

relations.evidence: Modai has diff (jdiff) wordsDiff highlighting any changes git style.
Modai integrates ChatGPT and Gemini directly into your Obsidian writing workflow.

summary: AI writing assistant that rewrites, edits and reviews selected text or whole notes using role-based prompts and custom LLM instructions, with a diff review panel.
